parameters.query:
SELECT c.id, c.composite_url
FROM consult.consults c
WHERE c.id = $1::bigint
  AND c.composite_url IS NOT NULL
  AND c.composite_image IS NULL;

UPDATE consult.consults
   SET composite_image = $2,
       updated_at      = now()
 WHERE id = $1::bigint
   AND composite_url = $3;   -- skip if the photo was changed again meanwhile
